package.description: USB drivers that connect Ingenico payment terminals to a PC.

en-US.description: USB drivers that connect Ingenico payment terminals to a PC.
en-US.longDescription: The Ingenico USB Driver application installs the drivers required to connect Ingenico payment terminals to a PC over USB, including the IngenicoEnum, IngenicoVBus and IngenicoVCOM driver components for both 32-bit and 64-bit Windows systems.
en-US.name: Ingenico USB Drivers
